title: Tenure
description: Who held which office, from when to when. This is the record that lets an indicator chart carry a time-axis annotation. It is deliberately NOT a claim: a claim can be plotted, aggregated, and compared, and a tenure must never be any of those things. Keeping it a separate record type means the chart code physically cannot treat a person's term as a data series. See CLAUDE.md rule 10.

$comment.description: Commentary on a fixture. Permitted in tests/fixtures only; validate.ts rejects this key anywhere under /data.

office.description: The office, not the person. Offices outlive their holders.

to.description: Omit while the tenure is current. An absent 'to' means ongoing, never unknown.

party_at_time.description: Recorded because it is a fact about the period. Never used to colour anything: SPEC section 8 forbids categorical colour implying party identity.

overlaps_permitted.description: Two tenures for one office normally indicate a data error, so CI rejects them. Set this on both records when an overlap is genuine — an acting appointment during a leave of absence, for instance — and say why in the note.

note.description: Neutral. Records circumstance, never assessment: 'appointed following resignation', not 'took over the struggling ministry'.

evidence.description: A tenure is evidence-backed like anything else. 'Everyone knows who was Prime Minister' is not a source.
